title: Analog & power circuits
circuit: Picker: buck converter (Lecture Ex. 2), half-wave SCR rectifier with R load (Ex. 5), CE amplifier (Sheet 5 circuit i)

candidates.name: CircuitJS, stock
candidates.oneLine: CircuitJS exactly as it ships, dark canvas, menus and editing, inside the pad frame.
candidates.accuracy: Not re-measured here; same circuits/ files measured in CircuitJS by the circuit-sim prototype (buck Vo 19.52 V vs 20, SCR 40.18 V vs 40.5, CE Av −157 vs −163.3).
candidates.caveats: Looks like CircuitJS, not the pad; students can edit or break the circuit; no idealisation switch; sidebar shows a 404 from the self-hosted copy.

candidates.name: CircuitJS, pad skin
candidates.oneLine: Locked CircuitJS multiplied onto the grid, pad sliders and toggle outside, live readouts.
candidates.accuracy: Live CircuitJS values vs circuits/expected.json in headless Chrome: ideal buck Vo 19.97 V, SCR Vo,av 40.50 V, CE Q-point within 0.3%, Av −154.8 (5% VT gap noted).
candidates.caveats: Sliders re-import edited circuit text on release (sim restarts); buck runs ~1 ms circuit time per second; phone shows CircuitJS's menu button and padlock.

candidates.name: Pad-native SPICE
candidates.oneLine: Hand-drawn pad schematic, current dots and grid plots, all solved live by ngspice-WASM.
candidates.accuracy: check-pad-native-spice.mjs: 90 PASS / 0 FAIL — same engine in Node vs expected.json (both modes), a 40 ms reference run, and hand formulas across slider ranges.
candidates.caveats: 20 MB ngspice engine (5.7 MB gzipped) before the first solve; schematics hand-drawn per circuit; DCM and saturation get a warning, not formulas.
